input: show missing/changed history inputs and warnings
expected: the History window lists each recorded feature, its recipe id, state and a detail naming the missing source id; a missing rail input is reported with its role, with no silent repair and an explicit Edit/Clear remediation
notes: broken_links reports the recipe id, command, state, missing input roles, changed input roles and the matching source object ids; a Clean recipe with intact bindings never appears.
The History window shows the recipe id, the detail (`missing input <role> (source <id>)` or `stale: <reason>`) and the Edit/Clear remediation; nothing is repaired silently.
Dirty/Unresolved/Failed rows are warnings too, so a parameter edit with update off (or a source revision change) is visible without being called missing.
The row is derived from the graph, not cached UI state, so a reopen re-reports the phantom reference.
